basis: aggregates only; measured rows come from committed synthetic real-shaped fixtures because the owner's vault is local-first and not agent-readable (ADR 0009); owner-pending rows are stated, never estimated

measured.label: Forecast absolute error at 30d
measured.method: absolute error of the projected close vs the actual ledger at the 30/60/90-day checkpoint, as a percentage of the opening position; #290 real-shaped fixture

measured.label: Forecast absolute error at 60d
measured.method: absolute error of the projected close vs the actual ledger at the 30/60/90-day checkpoint, as a percentage of the opening position; #290 real-shaped fixture

measured.label: Forecast absolute error at 90d
measured.method: absolute error of the projected close vs the actual ledger at the 30/60/90-day checkpoint, as a percentage of the opening position; #290 real-shaped fixture

measured.label: Internal-transfer match rate
measured.method: 12 of 12 labelled same-day pairs auto-confirmed, 0 pairs left as suggestions; real-shaped synthetic vault

measured.label: Uncategorized share
measured.method: 0 of 160 fixture transactions have no category under the built-in tiers; synthetic vault

ownerPending.label: Forecast error on the owner's history
ownerPending.reason: the personal vault is encrypted and local-first (ADR 0009); #303 owner-blocked
ownerPending.definition: as above, on the last three complete months of the owner's own ledger

ownerPending.label: Internal-transfer match rate on the owner's vault
ownerPending.reason: needs the owner's ledger and 30 days of decisions; #303 owner-blocked
ownerPending.definition: confirmed pairs / (confirmed + rejected + still-suggested after 30 days)

ownerPending.label: Uncategorized share on the owner's ledger
ownerPending.reason: needs the owner's last three complete months; #303 owner-blocked
ownerPending.definition: transactions without a category / all transactions

ownerPending.label: Statement coverage
ownerPending.reason: needs the owner's first-account date and imported-document months; #303 owner-blocked
ownerPending.definition: months with at least one statement document / months since the first account opened

ownerPending.label: Realised-gain reconciliation
ownerPending.reason: needs the broker's own realised/cash statement; fixture tests prove the report runs, not an independent reconciliation
ownerPending.definition: realised gains + income from the report minus the broker's reported movement; unknown when the broker does not report it

ownerPending.label: MCP tool calls per week and error rate
ownerPending.reason: needs the production server audit rows; no live MCP traffic exists from a local check
ownerPending.definition: tool calls per week and the ok/refused/error counts from the audit table

ownerPending.label: AI spend per operation and per account per month
ownerPending.reason: needs live agent usage; a local check makes no model calls
ownerPending.definition: cost per operation and per account per month from the AI usage ledger

ownerPending.label: Time to close a month
ownerPending.reason: a wall-clock measurement only the owner can take
ownerPending.definition: minutes from starting the month-close routine to trusting the numbers
